static_traits.name: Chen Yalin
static_traits.occupation: Nursing Student (future Nurse), indie band lead singer
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with band members have become tense due to negative views of performances; although band members and friends are available to talk to, hesitant about expressing 'hopelessness'
static_traits.medical_history: Without similar prior psychological problems; without past psychotherapy; without significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to self-reflect and identify thought patterns; good cooperation; relatively stable emotions (Neutral attitude)

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling Depression and hopelessness after the band's most recent failed performance, tending to catastrophize, believing things always go wrong, and thus feeling Anxiety before every performance and doubting one's ability as a singer.
basic_info.core_demands: The recent performance failure and persistent negative thoughts made me realize I need professional help to manage these feelings.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough (as a singer)
Things always go wrong / I will keep failing

special_situations.event: The band's failure at an important performance (sound problems, wrong notes, cold audience reaction)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one performance has mistakes, it means I am an incompetent singer and will keep botching performances
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces willingness to go on stage, avoids discussing performance with teammates to avoid negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This shows I am not good enough, and it will be like this in the future.

special_situations.event: Sound check/rehearsal before the performance going not smoothly or not perfectly
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the sound check is not perfect, the whole performance will definitely fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly rehearsing worst-case scenarios in mind, over-focusing on possible mistakes to 'prepare in advance'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The sound check is already not smooth; tonight is definitely doomed.

special_situations.event: Small mistakes in rehearsal (such as unstable handling somewhere/singing wrong)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the rehearsal goes wrong, the formal performance will be a complete failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Develops a strong stage-avoidance tendency; reduces facing pressure situations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once I make a mistake, the whole game is ruined.

special_situations.event: Seeing the audience's lukewarm reaction during the performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the audience reaction is Average, it means they will think I am a terrible singer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids feedback exchange with teammates or audiences to escape possible negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am terrible.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and affirmed (as a singer and Student)
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure and negative evaluation; feelings of shame are aroused
defense_goal: Lowers disappointment and shame through preemptive pessimism and avoiding discussion
Maintaining a sense of safety through control and vigilance (rehearsing the worst)

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough performer who could fail at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Picky, harshly critical audience or teammates

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes using behavioral experiments to challenge negative assumptions and invites setting concrete goals and collecting data
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying the outcome will prove oneself not good enough, leading to feeling failure and shame again
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in a calm, objective tone, emphasizing plans and data, reducing emotional wording, and avoiding going into emotional details.

manifestations: Pressure of choosing and balancing between academics (nursing) and band commitments
Trade-offs over roles and responsibilities bring tension and inner conflict
outcomes: Sleep affected and Declining academic performance

manifestations: Although band members and friends are available to talk to, hesitant about expressing hopelessness
Reducing genuine communication for fear of negative reviews

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to perform some behavior toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others outwardly to do something for him, and instead does it to himself.
manifestations: Usually avoids discussing one's own performance with teammates to avoid negative evaluation
Turning the need for outward expression into self-criticism and Self-doubt

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent Self-doubt and presuming others' negative evaluations
Cautious in interactions, difficult to directly seek support and feedback

positive_force: Has potential social support resources such as band members and friends
Can notice and name one's own thinking patterns such as catastrophizing and jumping to conclusions
Proactively seeks professional help; willing to try new coping methods
negative_force: Significant negative cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, black-and-white thinking and predicting the future
High Anxiety before performances and developing a tendency to avoid going on stage
Avoids communicating feedback with teammates, worries about negative evaluation
Great dual pressure from academics and the band; time and energy allocation causes tension
Sleep impaired and declining academics intensify the negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Intense Anxiety before performances and the tendency to avoid going on stage
antecedent: Associating it with lukewarm audience reactions or future performances
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking lead to high Fear of failure and negative evaluation
target_behavior.function: Briefly escaping potential failure and shame, temporarily lowering Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Affecting performance preparation and delivery, weakening confidence; Sleep impaired, declining academics, Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding discussing with and getting feedback from teammates
antecedent: After flaws appear in a performance or rehearsal
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being negated and shame being triggered, tending to reduce pain through avoidance
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome evaluations and emotional stimuli, maintaining fragile self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Missing constructive feedback and support, team Relationship tension, negative beliefs not corrected
